title: Kununu Company Salaries Scraper
description: Collect Kununu salary ranges by employer and country, with job titles, minimums, maximums, medians, averages, and report counts. Batch company slugs for pay comparisons.

batch.title: Company slugs
batch.description: Kununu company slugs whose reported salary ranges you want to collect.
batch.valueDescription: Company Slug used to run this search.

schema.description: Kununu country market code, such as de, at, or ch. Accepted values: de, at, ch.
Company slug from the public Kununu employer profile URL.

comments.text: Salary bands are reviewed each year.

storeCopy.seoDescription: Scrape Kununu salary ranges by company and country. Export job titles, pay minimums, maximums, medians, averages, and report counts for comparison.
storeCopy.intro: Collect company-level Kununu salary ranges with job titles, minimums, maximums, medians, averages, and report counts. Batch employer slugs for pay comparisons by country.
useCases: Compensation teams can benchmark reported pay by job title.
Labor-market analysts can compare salary ranges across employers.
Job seekers can research reported pay bands before applying.
howToUse: Add a Kununu company slug to each entry in `companies`.
Choose the country for the employer salary data.
Use `maxResults` to cap saved job-title salary ranges.

faqs.question: Are salary values official employer pay bands?
faqs.answer: No. Kununu salary figures reflect the information available in its salary pages and may be based on employee-submitted reports.
